QOHEFB.definition: Quantum-Overwatch Eternal Flame Blockchain; treated here as a symbolic root-of-trust namespace for signed model artifacts.

Somatic Handshake.definition: Privacy-preserving liveness and consent gate using biometric-derived commitments rather than raw biometric storage.

Ternary Weight Map.definition: Quantized model parameter representation using {-1, 0, +1} with scale factors per tensor block.

Sentinel LoRA.definition: Public agent shard focused on monitoring, rejection logic, and safe operational status summaries.

Alchemist LoRA.definition: Public agent shard focused on transformation, synthesis, and code/document scaffolding.

Oracle LoRA.definition: Public agent shard focused on retrieval, citation, summarization, and uncertainty calibration.
